subject: Order Form — billing plan reconciliation and PO / tax details
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@linlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Order Form: billing plan reconciliation for Redwood pilot

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for yesterday's workshop — the team is excited to move the pilot into a paid Order Form. I've attached our internal redline of the draft Order Form (linline-orderform-draft.pdf). Before we sign, procurement has asked for clarity on a few commercial items:

- Invoicing cadence: do you invoice monthly in advance or monthly in arrears? Our AP requires consolidated monthly invoices that reference a PO.
- Minimum commit billing: will the minimum commitment be invoiced monthly, quarterly, or on signature? We prefer quarterly invoicing for budgeting.
- Net terms: we'd like Net45 if possible (our standard).
- Taxes: please confirm whether Redwood will gross-up invoices for VAT/sales tax or if we should self-assess.

Can we get a short note confirming the above and a one-hour procurement call this week to align? I copied our procurement lead (procurement@linlinehealth.com).

Regards,
Elena Morales
Director, Partnerships
Linline Health

Attachments: linline-orderform-draft.pdf (Order Form redline)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@linlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order Form: billing plan reconciliation for Redwood pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the redline and the clear list. Short answers up front, and then proposed next steps: 

- Invoicing cadence: Redwood defaults to monthly invoicing in arrears (we bill for usage in the prior month). We can produce a single consolidated invoice that references your PO.
- Minimum commit: typically invoiced monthly (pro-rated if mid-quarter changes). We can discuss quarterly invoice options if that's a hard requirement.
- Net terms: standard is Net30; Net45 is possible but needs Finance approval for new customers.
- Taxes: we currently pass-through taxes and show tax separately on invoices; for non-US customers we may request tax documentation to support zero-rating.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik and I will prepare a short billing table showing "invoice cadence / when min commit is charged / how taxes appear." I'll attach a one-page cheat-sheet.
2) If you confirm PO number and billing address, we can update the Order Form to add a PO reference line and tax clause.
3) If Net45 is required, we'll route to Finance (cc'ing Lauren).

Can we lock a 30-minute procurement slot Tue/Wed?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-billing-cheat-sheet.pdf (one-pager)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@linlinehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Order Form: billing plan reconciliation for Redwood pilot — proposed billing table

Elena / Neha — attaching a proposed billing table to make this concrete. Key points: 

- Invoice cadence: monthly, consolidated, issued on the 3rd business day of the month for prior-month usage.
- Minimum commit: invoiced monthly as a recurring charge; example row in attached spreadsheet shows monthly invoice amount = committed units * unit price. If Linline prefers quarterly invoicing, we can aggregate and invoice the quarter up-front but that requires a contract amendment to the Order Form.
- Net terms: finance will need to approve Net45. If approved, there is a standard ACH/Banking set-up and an updated payment schedule in the Order Form.
- PO requirements: invoice will include a "PO#" field; please confirm the exact PO wording and invoice remittance address.
- Taxes: Redwood will show taxes on each invoice; for US entities we collect sales tax where applicable and provide tax detail.

If this looks good I will: 1) update the Order Form billing table; 2) loop in Lauren (Finance) for Net45 approval; 3) schedule a procurement call.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: proposed-billing-table.xlsx (example table)

From: Ben Chu <ben.chu@linlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@linlinehealth.com, Elena Morales <elena.morales@linlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order Form: billing plan reconciliation for Redwood pilot — procurement notes

Thanks all — a few clarifications from procurement's side after reviewing the proposed table and our PO process: 

1) Net terms: Linline's standard is Net45. We are willing to accept Net30 for pilots under $25k, otherwise Net45 is our baseline.
2) PO/reference: our AP requires the invoice to state "Invoice against PO: <PO#>" and to include the cost center code. We will provide a PO number at signature; invoices without the PO cannot be processed.
3) Minimum commit billing: our preference is that minimum commit is invoiced quarterly in advance to reduce credit risk. Monthly invoicing is acceptable for pilots if Redwood cannot support quarterly billing.
4) Taxes: Linline is based in the US (CA). We will provide tax-exemption documentation if applicable.

Attached is our PO guide and AP intake flow. Please confirm whether Redwood can: (a) issue a quarterly invoice for the min commit, and (b) include the PO reference as required.


Best,
Ben Chu
Procurement Manager
Linline Health

Attachments: LIN_PO_GUIDE.pdf (PO requirements)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@linlinehealth.com>, Ben Chu <ben.chu@linlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order Form: billing plan reconciliation for Redwood pilot — next steps

Hi Elena / Ben — appreciate the clear procurement notes. Quick summary and proposed compromise so we can move towards signature: 

- PO & invoice reference: we will include the exact PO number and cost center on the invoice. Please provide the PO wording/format and remittance address so we can template the invoice.
- Quarterly min-commit invoice: Redwood prefers monthly invoicing by default. For this pilot we can make an exception and invoice the minimum commit on a quarterly cadence (in advance) provided the Order Form explicitly calls out the quarterly billing schedule. Karthik — please reflect this in the Order Form amendment.
- Net terms: Lauren (cc'd, Finance) — can you confirm whether we can accept Net45 for Linline for the initial 12 months? If not, propose Net30 for pilot then Net45 for subsequent renewals.
- Taxes: we'll include tax lines on invoices and accept any tax-exemption documents you provide. If Linline needs gross-up language, that will need review from Legal.

Action items: 
1) Karthik to circulate Order Form amendment with quarterly billing row and PO field (by EOD Wed).
2) Lauren to confirm Net45 approval or provide alternate terms (by EOD Thu).
3) Elena/Ben to send PO format and billing address.
4) Neha/Marissa to schedule a 30-min procurement touchpoint if needed.

If those timelines work we'll aim to get to signature next week.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
